TERMINAL: a decorator on ToolLoopExecutor.run (modules/tools/execution/reply_chips_turn.py ends_on_reply_chips) wraps the caller's on_tool_result and on_round_end; after a round in which the tool succeeded (called directly, or as platform_execute's action), on_round_end returns ToolPostResult(force_final=True, final_content=<the round's own text, from the assistant message the loop just appended>), and _force_synthesize answers with no model call (tool_loop.py:343-359). The result's response carries reply_chips. A round with no text is not ended early (the loop goes on as today: one more model call writes the answer, and the chips still ride it). A turn that called platform_get_brief is never ended early and carries no chips ('never on the brief'). acceptanceCriteria: A new router orchestrator/api/auto_calibration.py, RouterSpec('api.auto_calibration'), plain def, authenticated and workspace-scoped (K22): GET /api/auto/calibration {available, offer, consent_line, status, calibration?, rejected_lines, accepted_lines}; POST /api/auto/calibration {consent, chat_id?, locale?}; POST /api/auto/calibration/{calibration_id}/lines/{line_id}/reject; POST /api/auto/calibration/{calibration_id}/accept. config CALIBRATION_ENABLED = False (config.py, config-surface.json): while it is off, GET answers available false and every POST is 404 not_available

The POST claims once per (workspace, person) with INSERT … ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING (services/calibration/claim.py). consent false records 'declined' with no model call. consent true builds (US-C22a) and posts one message [text, calibration@1] through deliver_background_message with W2's parts ('calibration@1' joins services/chat_parts.py STRUCTURED_PART_TYPES), into chat_id when it is the person's own chat in the workspace, else their Auto thread, source {origin 'calibration', calibration_id}, not announced, and answers {calibration, chat_id, message_id}. A second POST answers 409 already_offered with the existing record. A failed build or post releases the claim

Reject writes one correction and accept writes one memory per line not rejected, through the memory service exactly as K16 says (services/calibration/memory.py); each is idempotent; only the calibration's own person may answer it (404 for anyone else and any other workspace); a line that violates_exclusions is never stored and the answer says so; a failed write is 503 and changes nothing. Consent, decline, accept and each reject write an audit row after the commit. The mutating routes carry require_workspace_permission and are in route-manifest.json
Discovery lists calibration -> ('POST', '/api/auto/calibration') only while CALIBRATION_ENABLED is on (CONFIGURED_CAPABILITIES), and test_prd266_discovery.py's KNOWN_CAPABILITIES gains it (K20)

New tests orchestrator/tests/test_prd268w3_calibration_routes.py (realdb: off answers not_available; consent posts one message with the calibration@1 part into the caller's own chat, and another member's chat id falls back to the caller's Auto thread; decline makes no model call; once only, also under two concurrent POSTs; a failed build leaves no claim; reject and accept idempotent; another person and another workspace 404; discovery off and on; the manifest; plain def) and orchestrator/tests/test_prd268w3_calibration_memory.py (the memory service mocked at store_long_term: content, metadata owner, private scope, source_type, extra and subject_id per K16; exclusions; a failed write)
userStories.notes: The claim pattern: W2's services/brief/claim.py and services/mobile/digest.py claim :210-220 / release :223-226. W2's parts: services/chat_parts.py STRUCTURED_PART_TYPES and checked_parts (RE-VERIFY after W2, US-C19b). The memory service: modules/memory/unified_memory_service.py get_unified_memory_service and store_long_term :321-371; modules/memory/write_contract.py MEMORY_FACT_TYPES :41-53, default_scope_for_type :70-80, violates_exclusions :167, build_memory_metadata :198-255; the subject tag is 'user:<users.id>' (modules/memory/forget.py subject_of :22-26). discovery.py CAPABILITY_ROUTES :64-72, CONFIGURED_CAPABILITIES :75-77. The test pin: tests/test_prd266_discovery.py:68. W2 left useCalibration and useAnswerCalibration inert for these routes (W2's K12): read their expected shapes in hooks/use-calibration.ts and lib/proactive/types.ts on W2's tip and answer in them. Security review: consent before any read, memory writes (owner, scope, exclusions), tenancy, and the post only into the person's own chat.

userStories.title: Reply chips on the web: under Auto's newest message, a tap sends, gone once a newer message exists
userStories.description: As a person on the web, I want Auto's likely answers as taps under its last message (PRD-268 §6.6, §6.12.3, §6.12.4, US-W03, K12, K13, K19).
acceptanceCriteria: frontend/types/chat.ts ChatMessage gains replyChips? and followUps?. frontend/lib/chat/turn-parts.ts reads the live 'turn_parts' tool-data frame and a saved message's reply_chips@1 and follow_up@1 parts, checked off the wire (a malformed part is ignored, never thrown). lib/chat/use-chat-with-receipts.ts puts the live ones on the last assistant message, as it does the receipts

W2's components/proactive/thread-cards.tsx draws W2's ReplyChips under an assistant message from its chips only while it is the chat's newest message: components/proactive/newest-message.ts is a useSyncExternalStore store, per chat, that message-with-receipts.tsx registers each rendered message into. message.tsx and chat.tsx are untouched (K4)

A tap dispatches the window event automatos:reply-chip {chatId, text}; W2's components/proactive/composer-with-suggestion.tsx sends it through its sendMessage as the person's own message (role user, a text part), and does nothing while a turn is streaming. Free text stays available
Each chip is named 'Reply: <chip>', carries data-ai-generated and renders its text as text; the voice never speaks it (it reads text parts only). Tokens only (K19)

New tests frontend/lib/chat/__tests__/turn-parts.test.ts (the frame, the saved parts, malformed input) and frontend/components/proactive/__tests__/thread-reply-chips.test.tsx (shown under the newest message only; gone once a newer one renders; a tap sends once and never while streaming; the names; data-ai-generated)
userStories.notes: message-with-receipts.tsx (42 lines on main; RE-VERIFY after W2: US-W01b made it draw thread-cards). use-chat-with-receipts.ts (74 lines; its onData seam, the receipts' liveReceiptsFromToolData, lib/chat/receipts.ts LIVE_KEY :83, :87). types/chat.ts receiptsAbove :218. multimodal-input.tsx MultimodalInputProps :26-37 (sendMessage, status) and composerMessage (the message shape; it is module-private: build the same shape in the wrapper). W2's files to RE-VERIFY: components/proactive/thread-cards.tsx, composer-with-suggestion.tsx, mission-suggestion-presence.ts (the store pattern), reply-chips.tsx (its props: US-C21d). chat.tsx renders the messages at :1079, :1211 and :1453 through the MessageWithReceipts alias :12.

userStories.title: Calibration on the web: the consent line once, one Auto card, Reject, Sounds right, Something's off
userStories.description: As a person on the web, on my first chat in a workspace, I want Auto to ask once, then say back what it knows so I can correct it (PRD-268 §6.11.5, §6.12.3, §6.12.4, US-W06, K15, K17).
acceptanceCriteria: hooks/use-calibration.ts (W2's, inert until now) goes live: useCalibration reads GET /api/auto/calibration and useAnswerCalibration posts the consent, a line's reject and the accept, through apiClient; their exported types do not change, and the SDK does not change (K17)

frontend/components/proactive/calibration-offer.tsx, rendered by W2's composer-with-suggestion.tsx above the composer in any chat until the person answers it, only when the server answers available and offer: the consent line from the server, Go ahead (the ink primary: posts consent true with the chat id and the page's locale) and Not now (consent false). Never shown when not available

thread-cards.tsx draws a calibration@1 part with W2's CalibrationCard and live state from useCalibration: each line with its source count and Reject (struck through with 'I'll forget that' once rejected), the 3 offers, Sounds right (accept) and Something's off (sends 'Something's off' as the person's message through the reply-chip path). No percentage anywhere. The state survives a reload
Studio light, Studio dark and Classic from tokens; the lines carry data-ai-generated; the controls do not

New tests frontend/components/proactive/__tests__/calibration-offer.test.tsx (shown once while offered, Go ahead and Not now post once each, hidden when unavailable), frontend/components/proactive/__tests__/thread-calibration.test.tsx (the card from the part, Reject, Sounds right, Something's off sends, no '%') and frontend/hooks/__tests__/use-calibration-live.test.tsx (the GET, the POSTs, available false makes no POST)
userStories.notes: W2's files to RE-VERIFY: hooks/use-calibration.ts and lib/proactive/types.ts (Calibration@1, US-C21b), components/proactive/calibration-card.tsx (its props, US-C21d), lib/theme-sdk/proactive.ts (re-exports the hooks: leave it unchanged), components/proactive/composer-with-suggestion.tsx (US-W01b). userStories.title: The browser lane: chips, the follow-up line and calibration in Studio light, Studio dark and Classic
userStories.description: As the owner, I want real-browser proof that the W3 web surfaces read right in every built-in look (PRD-268 §6.12.4).
acceptanceCriteria: e2e/browser/specs/proactive-w3.spec.ts renders, under Studio light, Studio dark and Classic, with the backend answers fulfilled as the lane's other specs do: chips under Auto's last message, a tap that sends its text and the chips gone after; the follow-up line with Cancel; the consent line and the calibration card. It attaches a screenshot of each, and Auto's words carry data-ai-generated in the DOM
No new dependency (e2e/browser/package.json is exact-pinned; W2's K18 still holds axe), and browser-e2e.yml is unchanged (its path filter covers e2e/browser/**)
userStories.notes: Patterns: e2e/browser/specs/host-cards.spec.ts (support/backend-route fulfillBackendJson; support/hello-theme chooseStyle) and W2's specs/proactive-defaults.spec.ts (RE-VERIFY after W2, US-C21f). The lane runs Chromium and WebKit; a WebKit 'internal error' on reload is the Playwright 1.57 flake (rerun it), not app code.
